about_arch_p1: Pizza Converter is engineered from the ground up with Tauri v2 and an asynchronous, multi-threaded Rust core engine. Conversions leverage direct memory streams, SIMD-accelerated image decoding, and isolated worker processes to deliver instantaneous conversions with minimal system memory footprint.
about_arch_p2: All intelligent features — including neural background removal, AI video highlight extraction, 9:16 speaker tracking, speech-to-subtitle transcription, adaptive scan enhancement, and PDF security manipulation — execute locally on your machine.
about_oss_p: Pizza Converter incorporates open-source components under standard permissive licenses (including FFmpeg under GNU LGPL v2.1, Faster-Whisper, OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, and Tauri). All components are used in strict compliance with their respective licenses.
aig_sec_overview: PIZZA CONVERTER AI · COMPLETE FEATURE ENCYCLOPEDIA
aig_hero_sub: Every AI and smart tool runs locally on your PC & Mac — zero cloud rendering fees, instant radial wheel access via Ctrl+G / ⌘G.
aig_f1_title: 1. AI Video Highlight Studio & 9:16 Auto Face-Tracking
aig_f1_desc: Select any video (≥ 5 min) → AI Highlight. Automatically detects viral hooks, summarizes key points, or removes filler silences. Includes OpenCV 9:16 Auto Re-Layout: 1 Face → dynamic speaker crop; 2 Faces → top/bottom split-screen; Presentation/Screen → centered fit so slides are never cut off.
aig_f2_desc: Select any Video or Audio file → AI Subtitles. Powered by local Faster-Whisper INT8 speech recognition with millisecond word timestamps and automatic language detection across 99+ languages.
aig_f3_title: 3. AI Burn-In Stylized Captions (6 Signature Word-by-Word Styles)
aig_f3_desc: Select any Video → Burn Captions. Opens Ring 2 with 6 kinetic karaoke styles: Beasty (yellow pop), Popline (purple pill), Deep Diver (frosted box), One Punch (giant kinetic), Glow (cyan neon), and Role-Play (speaker-colored dialogue + contextual emojis).
aig_f4_title: 4. AI Context-Aware Video Dubbing (100+ Languages & Male/Female Pitch)
aig_f4_desc: Select any Video → AI Dubbing. Analyzes the entire transcript for natural role/relationship pronouns (Family, Review/Vlog, Formal), measures acoustic F0 pitch (<168Hz Male / ≥168Hz Female) to match speaker gender, mixes background ambiance, and optionally burns translated captions.
aig_f5_desc: Select any Audio file (.MP3, .WAV, .M4A, .FLAC) → Audiogram. Renders a studio MP4 video with real-time acoustic waveforms (Daily Cafe, Vinyl Vibes, After Dark, Studio Pulse), custom branding, and auto-transcribed synced lyrics.
aig_f6_title: 6. Document / PDF / Word → Spoken Audiobook MP3
aig_f6_desc: Select any .PDF, .DOCX, .TXT, or .MD document → Audio MP3. Extracts clean document text, automatically detects the language (Vietnamese, English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, French, etc.), and synthesizes a natural neural voiceover MP3.
aig_f7_title: 7. AI Neural Background Removal (1-Click Transparent PNG)
aig_f7_desc: Select any Image (.JPG, .PNG, .WEBP, .HEIC) → Remove BG. Runs local ONNX U²-Net / BiRefNet neural segmentation to isolate people, products, logos, or objects with hair-level alpha precision.
aig_f8_title: 8. 1-Click AI OCR Text & Table Extraction (Auto-Copy to Clipboard)
aig_f8_desc: Select any Screenshot, Receipt, or Scanned Photo → OCR Text. Recognizes multi-language text (Vietnamese + English + CJK), saves a clean _ocr.txt file, and automatically copies the extracted text to your clipboard so you can press Ctrl+V immediately.
aig_f9_title: 9. Clean EXIF, GPS Location & AI Generation Fingerprints
aig_f9_desc: Select any Image or Video → Clean EXIF/AI. Strips hidden GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, Apple/Samsung maker notes, and AI generation watermarks/metadata (C2PA, JUMBF, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, Sora, ComfyUI XMP/PNG chunks) and re-masters pixel/bitstream headers.
aig_sec_smart: ⚡ SMART COMPRESSION, PDF MERGE & WI-FI DROP
aig_f10_title: 10. Target-Size Video & Image Compressor (Exact MB Guarantee)
aig_f10_desc: Select any Video → Compress MB to open Ring 2 with exact size targets: < 10 MB (Discord), < 25 MB (Gmail), < 50 MB (Telegram/Zalo), or 50% Size. Uses exact duration bitrate math + strict -fs ceiling so the output never exceeds the target. On Images, click Compress for smart Web/JPEG optimization.
aig_f11_desc: Select 2 or more Images and click Merge PDF to bind them into a single multi-page PDF book in exact selection order (auto-rotates EXIF orientation). Select 2+ PDFs or 2+ Videos to merge them seamlessly.
aig_f12_title: 12. Cloud Drop + Instant QR Code + Phone → PC Wi-Fi Drop
aig_f12_desc: Upload any file to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or Local Wi-Fi and click 📱 QR on the HUD toast to scan and download on your phone. Or press Ctrl+G with no file selected → click Phone → PC → scan the QR code on your iPhone/Android to beam photos & videos straight to your PC Downloads folder!
